bash: cat > /tmp/verify.sh <<'EOS'
#!/bin/sh
cd /app || exit 1
fail=0
RES=$(jq -n --slurpfile inp users.json --slurpfile out active_users_report.json '
  ($inp[0]) as $i | ($out[0]) as $o |
  ([$i[] | select(.status == "active")] | length) as $nactive |
  ($i | map({key: (.id|tostring), value: .}) | from_entries) as $byid |
  [
    {n:"output is exactly one JSON array", ok: (($out|length) == 1 and ($o|type) == "array")},
    {n:"user count equals number of active users (\($nactive))", ok: (($o|length) == $nactive)},
    {n:"set of output user_ids == set of active ids", ok: (([$o[].user_id]|sort) == ([$i[]|select(.status=="active")|.id]|sort))},
    {n:"every object has exactly the 6 fields in the specified order", ok: ([$o[] | (keys_unsorted == ["user_id","username","email","last_login","role_count","primary_role"])] | all)},
    {n:"all user_id are numbers", ok: ([$o[] | (.user_id|type) == "number"] | all)},
    {n:"last_login matches ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$", ok: ([$o[] | (.last_login|test("^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$"))] | all)},
    {n:"role_count is a non-negative integer", ok: ([$o[] | (.role_count|type)=="number" and (.role_count == (.role_count|floor)) and .role_count >= 0] | all)},
    {n:"primary_role is a string or JSON null", ok: ([$o[] | ((.primary_role|type)=="string") or .primary_role==null] | all)},
    {n:"username and email copied from the input record with the same id", ok: ([$o[] | ($byid[(.user_id|tostring)]) as $r | ($r != null) and .username == $r.username and .email == $r.email] | all)},
    {n:"every source record is active", ok: ([$o[] | $byid[(.user_id|tostring)].status == "active"] | all)},
    {n:"no inactive/pending user leaked in", ok: ([$o[] | ($byid[(.user_id|tostring)].status == "inactive" or $byid[(.user_id|tostring)].status == "pending")] | any | not)},
    {n:"last_login equals the UTC date part of the source timestamp", ok: ([$o[] | .last_login == ($byid[(.user_id|tostring)].last_login[0:10])] | all)},
    {n:"role_count equals length of source roles", ok: ([$o[] | .role_count == ($byid[(.user_id|tostring)].roles|length)] | all)},
    {n:"primary_role equals source roles[0] (null when empty)", ok: ([$o[] | ($byid[(.user_id|tostring)].roles) as $rs | .primary_role == ($rs[0] // null)] | all)},
    {n:"empty roles give role_count 0 and primary_role null", ok: ([$o[] | select(($byid[(.user_id|tostring)].roles|length) == 0) | (.role_count == 0 and .primary_role == null)] | all)},
    {n:"non-empty roles give a non-null primary_role", ok: ([$o[] | select(($byid[(.user_id|tostring)].roles|length) > 0) | .primary_role != null] | all)},
    {n:"usernames sorted ascending", ok: (([$o[].username]) == ([$o[].username]|sort))},
    {n:"all 6 fields present with no nulls except primary_role", ok: ([$o[] | select((.user_id==null) or (.username==null) or (.email==null) or (.last_login==null) or (.role_count==null))] | length == 0)}
  ] | .[] | "\(if .ok then "PASS" else "FAIL" end): \(.n)"
' 2>&1)
echo "$RES"
echo "$RES" | grep -q '^FAIL' && fail=1

jq --indent 2 '.' active_users_report.json > /tmp/ref.json 2>/dev/null
cmp -s /tmp/ref.json active_users_report.json && echo "PASS: byte-identical to jq --indent 2 re-serialization" || { echo "FAIL: indentation is not exactly 2 spaces"; fail=1; }
grep -qP '\t' active_users_report.json && { echo "FAIL: contains tabs"; fail=1; } || echo "PASS: no tab characters"
[ "$(sed -n '2p' active_users_report.json)" = '  {' ] && echo "PASS: first element indented by exactly 2 spaces" || { echo "FAIL: element indentation"; fail=1; }
[ -s active_users_report.json ] && [ -z "$(tail -c 1 active_users_report.json)" ] && echo "PASS: ends with a newline" || { echo "FAIL: trailing newline"; fail=1; }

sh cmd.sh 2>/tmp/cmd.err
[ -s /tmp/cmd.err ] && { echo "FAIL: cmd.sh wrote to stderr"; sed -n '1,5p' /tmp/cmd.err; fail=1; } || echo "PASS: cmd.sh runs cleanly"
cmp -s active_users_report.json /tmp/ref.json && echo "PASS: cmd.sh reproduces the report" || { echo "FAIL: cmd.sh output differs"; fail=1; }
grep -q 'jq' cmd.sh && grep -q '/app/users.json' cmd.sh && grep -q 'active_users_report.json' cmd.sh && echo "PASS: cmd.sh has jq, fixed input and output path" || { echo "FAIL: cmd.sh incomplete"; fail=1; }

K=$(yq -r '([keys_unsorted]|.[]|join(","))' jq_args.yaml)
[ "$K" = "filter,args" ] && echo "PASS: jq_args.yaml has exactly the keys filter,args" || { echo "FAIL: keys are $K"; fail=1; }
T=$(yq -r '(.filter|type) + "/" + ([.args[]|type]|unique|join(","))' jq_args.yaml)
[ "$T" = "string/string" ] && echo "PASS: filter is a string and every arg is a string" || { echo "FAIL: types $T"; fail=1; }
A=$(yq -r '.args[]' jq_args.yaml)
echo "$A" | grep -qE '/app|users\.json|active_users_report|select\(|^\[' && { echo "FAIL: args contain a filter or file path"; fail=1; } || echo "PASS: args contain no jq command, filter or file path"

jq $(yq -r '.args[]' jq_args.yaml) "$(yq -r '.filter' jq_args.yaml)" /app/users.json > /tmp/recon.json 2>/tmp/recon.err
[ -s /tmp/recon.err ] && { echo "FAIL: reconstruction wrote to stderr"; sed -n '1,5p' /tmp/recon.err; fail=1; } || echo "PASS: reconstruction command exits cleanly"
cmp -s /tmp/recon.json active_users_report.json && echo "PASS: the spec reconstruction command reproduces the report byte-for-byte" || { echo "FAIL: reconstruction differs"; fail=1; }

echo "-----"
[ $fail -eq 0 ] && echo "ALL CHECKS PASSED" || echo "THERE WERE FAILURES"
exit $fail
EOS
sh /tmp/verify.sh; echo "VERIFY_EXIT=$?"
